verdict.rationale: Docs directly describe the core loop: broadcasts are one-time campaigns sent to a broad audience or saved segment, with segment/tag/date filtering for audience selection, and API/UI support to 'create campaigns, and schedule approved sends with explicit audience rules.' Supporting concepts (segments, tags, sequences) reinforce audience targeting and scheduling capabilities. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent verification of the actual compose/send UI experience and no evidence of send-time optimization or A/B testing for broadcasts.
